records.text: Identify an existing account using its telephone number before considering its email address. Mailbox equality never grants merchant approval.
Exchange the authorization code for a session at the OAuth callback. Validate the destination and preserve the user's language when redirecting.
Keep credentials out of version control. Supply keys through environment variables. Rotate compromised tokens and redact them before persistence.
When the configured remote cannot be reached, keep local project evidence usable and mark upstream status unknown. Do not imply that no upstream changes exist.
A paused note writer retains its operating-system lock. Elapsed time cannot transfer ownership to another writer. A crashed process releases the lock.
Retry a durable progress note using its original idempotency key and identical semantic payload. The same key with changed text is a conflict, not a second note.
Count every token in the final serialized response, including metadata, omissions and continuation. Preserve a way to retrieve all omitted evidence.
An old observation is immutable historical evidence. A renamed source keeps its original pointer; a new location is not proof that it is the same source.
A current tombstone excludes the forgotten record from capture, lexical indexes, vector indexes and every retained generation, even if the original file remains.
Two linked Git worktrees share clone identity but retain separate branch and incoming memberships. Search eligibility is applied before candidate limits.
An item identifier names a logical source record. Content versions hash canonical payloads. Observing the same payload at a later revision creates a new observation, not a new content version.
A proposed replacement cannot displace an accepted decision. Only a replacement accepted under the declared approver policy can supersede it.
The historical retry delay was ten seconds. This accepted decision is retained for evidence but replaced by the current thirty-second policy.
The current retry delay is thirty seconds so a slow local provider has time to respond. This approved replacement supersedes the historical ten-second delay.
Mobile Safari acceptance includes sign-in cancellation, denied permissions, session persistence, sign-out and localized errors. A desktop-only check leaves this coverage unverified.
Semantic similarity supplies candidate evidence. It does not establish code calls, requirements, approval or successful verification. Preserve model and source version provenance.
Repair a missing derived SQLite index from surviving repository and harness sources. Refuse to downgrade a newer unsupported schema. Deleted supporting context must be restored by its owner.
Facebook authentication remains disabled until external application configuration, email permissions, credentials and callback allowlists are evidenced. A visible button is insufficient.
تطابق البريد الإلكتروني لا يمنح صلاحية التاجر. يجب فحص رقم الهاتف أولا قبل ربط الحساب عبر عنوان البريد.
يجب أن تبقى رسائل الخطأ وأزرار تسجيل الدخول باللغة العربية والإنجليزية، مع الحفاظ على اتجاه العرض من اليمين إلى اليسار.
التحقق على متصفح سفاري في الهاتف مطلوب. نجاح اختبار سطح المكتب لا يثبت استمرار الجلسة أو تسجيل الخروج على الجهاز المحمول.
نتيجة الاختبار تقرير منسوب إلى صاحبها. يجب حفظ الأمر وإصدار الشيفرة والبيئة والملفات المختبرة. تعديل الملفات يجعل الدليل السابق قديما.
The callback evidence is at apps/web/src/app/auth/callback/route.ts. Read the current file with the file search tool.
The current endpoint for the audit feed is /audit/v1. This record will be edited in the change fixture.
Cache decoded image thumbnails separately from original uploads. Evict least recently viewed thumbnails when disk pressure increases.
Delivery receipts track transactional email messages. A retry queue uses exponential delay for temporary SMTP failures.
Shopping cart totals include shipping and tax. Discount codes are checked before confirming a payment.
Charts use distinct line styles as well as colors so the legend remains usable for color-blind readers.
Record process resident memory, cold and warm latency, corpus size and dependency versions when evaluating a retrieval prototype.
Export tabular reports as CSV with quoted fields and a consistent header. Embedded commas must remain inside their field.
Normalize audio loudness before producing speech previews. Preserve the original recording for later editing.
Store event time zones explicitly. Daylight-saving transitions can make a local meeting time ambiguous.
